info.title: build_landing_zone_diagram
info.description: Render the engagement's target Azure landing-zone diagram (draw.io / .drawio) deterministically from its published design — the hub VNet and every spoke as a swimlane, hub components as cells, peering / ExpressRoute / VPN / DR edges, labelled with the engagement's target and DR regions. Fast and synchronous. Call it after design_landing_zone / publish_estimate; publish_estimate also regenerates it automatically.

post.summary: Render the target landing-zone diagram (.drawio) for an engagement
post.description: Pass {"engagement": "<customer>/<project>"}. Reads the engagement's landing-zone design from its published tools_raw.json, builds the .drawio XML, and stores landing_zone.drawio + landing_zone_diagram.json under the engagement. The dashboard's landing-zone card then shows the diagram inline with a Download .drawio link, and to_pptx / to_docx embed it. You can also pass {"design": {...design_landing_zone output...}} or {"applications": [...], "server_summary": {...}} to render without a stored estimate.

design.description: A design_landing_zone result to render directly (optional).

applications.description: Portfolio to design + render if no stored estimate (optional).

200.description: Diagram built (and stored, when an engagement was given)

drawio.description: The XML, returned inline only when no engagement was given.

409.description: No landing-zone design available to render
